name: 11004 · Glen Oaks, NY
findings: ZIP 11004 (Glen Oaks) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11004 (Glen Oaks) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
92% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
